name: gpt-cli
test_cmd: mkdir -p "$ENV/home" "$ENV/tmp" && HOME="$ENV/home" TMPDIR="$ENV/tmp" $PY -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/
notes: CI (.github/workflows/python-app.yml) runs plain `pytest` on Python 3.9 after `pip install .`; the task allows only 3.11/3.12 and pyproject has requires-python >=3.9,<3.13, so I used 3.11 (3.11.17). Installed editable (-e "$SRC"), so no reinstall step is needed; pytest~=8.3.4 is a runtime dependency, so no extras. The optional `llama` extra (llama-cpp-python) is not installed: llama.py guards the import and no test touches it. Resolved anthropic==0.47.2, openai==1.75.0, cohere==5.13.12, google-genai==1.10.0, pytest==8.3.5. 14 tests: tests/test_assistant.py (7 parametrized init_assistant cases) and tests/test_session.py (7 ChatSession tests on a MagicMock assistant). None constructs an SDK client or makes a provider call, so they exercise config/session logic only, not the provider modules. Nothing deselected. Baseline taken with RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY unset and outbound network denied (macOS sandbox-exec, loopback allowed; confirmed a TCP connect to 1.1.1.1 fails with EPERM). Two runs gave identical counts (14 passed; 3.79s cold first run, about 1.0s pytest / 1.35s wall after that). parse_counts reads {passed: 14, failed: 0, errors: 0, skipped: 0}.
